title: Numerical qualification and receipt harness
objective: Implement source-bound backend-neutral corpus, benchmark, portability and capability receipt tooling across P0-P8 without claiming unmeasured evidence

oracles: Self-verifying receipt schemas, fixture tamper tests and exact source/artifact hashes

handoff.summary: Implemented a registry-free P0-P8 numerical qualification framework on 9f435eb48. Backend-neutral corpora declare exact source closures, roadmap phases, workload tiers, deterministic campaigns, expected domain outcomes, and independently evaluated correctness/validation checks. Capability manifests bind corpus, source, adapter, and artifact hashes; immutable receipts bind those inputs to the real Git state, physical host, collector and exercised runtime while retaining warmup/sample wall time, adapter phase telemetry and counters, sampled/process RSS, startup, and installed payload. Explicit matrix policies preserve missing or duplicate host/runtime rows as failures and require passing phase/layer/capability/artifact evidence. The 13-test portable adversarial suite executes the five-case harness corpus end to end, including expected failure, fixed-seed fuzz, and metamorphic witnesses, and rejects tampering, stale bindings, duplicate JSON keys, forged platforms, unavailable capabilities, missing evidence, and receipt overwrite attempts.
risks: No product or non-Linux capability receipt is fabricated here: the checked-in self-test proves only the portable harness, and actual Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, native Windows x64, browser, worker, SEA, memory-pressure, cancellation, long-duration, payload, and performance rows remain missing until domain lanes collect them on the named runtimes and hosts.

The agreed numerical integration base has a stale optimizer-opportunity manifest, so the mandatory global architecture gate is not passable in this claimed lane. Merging current origin/main also requires a combined shared architecture/native-boundaries.json regeneration because the numerical callback probe and new msolve files both change the inventory; central integration owns that unclaimed resolution.

Receipt content IDs prove internal integrity and exact byte binding, not physical-host authorship. Release automation must preserve trusted host/job transport provenance or add external signatures. The documented 5 ms RSS sampler can miss short synchronous spikes, so process high-water RSS is retained separately.
next_steps: Central integration should merge current main, regenerate the combined shared inventories, run the three mandatory global validations with parallel:run on the integrated candidate, and then move this task from active to review.

Each numerical domain should add an in-claim corpus and adapter, explicitly check independent oracle/residual, campaign trial, failure, fuzz/metamorphic, cancellation, and memory-pressure evidence, then collect immutable receipts on every required physical host and exercised runtime.

The release coordinator should author an exact-digest matrix policy only after representative startup, memory, payload, and performance measurements exist; absent rows and budgets must remain absent rather than inferred from this self-test.
